name: ApeMotion – Page Transitions for Divi
author: Ape Media & Service

sections.description:
ApeMotion – Page Transitions for Divi delivers smooth, physics-based page transitions and lightweight preloaders to your Divi website. Eliminate browser white flash on navigation and give your visitors a polished, application-like experience.

ApeMotion is an independent third-party plugin developed by Ape Media & Services. It runs completely standalone with zero external dependencies, zero tracking, and no license keys required.

Included Features

  • 5 Distinct Page Transition Styles:
    • Fade
    • Slide (Right)
    • Curtain Flip (Style 1)
    • Morph Wave (Top)
    • Morph Spilling (Bottom Left)
  • 5 Lightweight Preloader Animations:
    • Box Assembling
    • Box Circling
    • Circle Filling
    • Circling 1
    • Dots
  • 2 Preloader Animation Effects:
    • Bounce
    • Fade In/Out (Quick)
  • Calibrated Motion Curve: Built with a smooth Ease In Out timing curve for natural-feeling transitions.
  • Live Admin Preview: Test and inspect your transition and preloader settings live in the settings dashboard before saving.
  • Smart Browser Cache Protection: Back-Forward cache (BFCache) safeguards to keep the interface interactive when visitors use the browser back button.
  • Zero External Dependencies: Self-contained code that requires no third-party CDNs, external tracking, or license keys.

Compatibility Note

Divi is a registered trademark of Elegant Themes, Inc. ApeMotion – Page Transitions for Divi is developed independently by Ape Media & Services and has no official affiliation with, sponsorship by, or endorsement from Elegant Themes, Inc.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the apemotion-page-transitions-divi folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ApeMotion in your WordPress admin menu to configure transitions and preloader settings.
  4. Save your changes and visit the frontend of your site to experience the transitions.
sections.faq:
Is ApeMotion a standalone plugin?

Yes. ApeMotion is a completely standalone plugin that requires no external dependencies or subscriptions.

Can I use ApeMotion with Divi 4 and Divi 5?

Yes. The plugin animates #page-container by default and includes automatic fallback detection across Divi builder environments and standard theme templates.

What easing curve is used?

ApeMotion uses a calibrated Ease In Out timing equation for all five included transitions to maintain consistent motion physics.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial standalone release for WordPress.org.
  • 5 core transition animations: Fade, Slide (Right), Curtain Flip (Style 1), Morph Wave (Top), Morph Spilling (Bottom Left).
  • 5 core preloader animations: Box Assembling, Box Circling, Circle Filling, Circling 1, Dots.
  • 2 preloader motion effects: Bounce, Fade In/Out (Quick).
  • Standalone settings manager with live admin previews.
